title: Kurara Pasina Nguva
intro: Fungidzira nguva apo chokwadi chakanyaradzwa uye vatendi vachivhimwa. Boka diki rakasarudza kudzokera shure pane kuzvipira, richiwana nzvimbo yekupotera munzvimbo dzisingatarisirwi - nzvimbo yaizova nzvimbo yavo yekuzorora kwemazana emakore asingaverengeki. Pavakazomuka, nyika yakanga yashanduka yakavapoteredza. Ndivanaani mweya iyi yakarara?
clues: Nharaunda yedu yakati tiite kunamata pamwe chete navo, asi takaramba.
Takabva muguta tichitsvaka nzvimbo yekupotera kune avo vaipikisa zvitendero zvedu.
Shamwari yakatendeka ine makumbo mana yakaramba iri pamusuwo wenzvimbo yedu yekuhwanda.
Mwari vakatiita kuti tirare kwemakore mazana matatu nemapfumbamwe.
Patakazomuka, guta redu raimbotambudzwa rakanga ragamuchira kutenda.

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Takamuka ndokuwana guta redu rava kutenda
Moto waipfuta wakava unotonhorera uye wakanyarara
outcome.answer: Takamuka ndokuwana guta redu rava kutenda

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
